stage_name_zh: 阶段 4：顶会论文、具身智能/生成建模、学术演讲与全周期综合复习（Day 76–116）
learning_objectives_zh: 通过 8 个核心词群（涵盖今日 28 个目标词条）掌握熟悉词汇的学术熟词生义（Polysemy）、一词多义边界、可数/及物性变化与自然搭配。
掌握句子成分精细分析（主、谓、宾、表、定、状、同位语）与核心语法：【G028】学术段落逻辑架构：主题句—机制解释—实证/实例支撑—范围限定；【G033】去除“AI 味（Anti-AI-ese）”与过度修辞：用具体机制、指标与实例替代空洞夸张。
掌握学术表达模式：【EP004】界定概念的操作性定义与数学符号表示，彻底消除头重脚轻、口语化、过度表达与空洞 AI 套话。
完成 36 道高密度、单点聚焦的实战练习，确保今日每个词条均获得至少 3 次训练（含至少 2 次主动输出）。

grammar_instruction.name: 学术段落逻辑架构：主题句—机制解释—实证/实例支撑—范围限定
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 无论是顶会论文 Discussion 还是六级/雅思托福主体段，高质量段落都必须具备“清晰主题句（Topic Sentence）-> 作用机制或理论解释（Mechanism/Warrant）-> 具体数据或实例（Concrete Evidence/Instance）-> 边界限定（Qualification）”四层逻辑，拒绝仅靠连接词填空。
rules: 防范逻辑跳跃（Logical Leap）：从“某现象存在或某指标提升”到“应全面推广某政策/模型”之间，必须补充成本、可行性（feasibility）或分布偏移（distribution shift）的权衡（trade-off）。
正确区分对比连接词：on the contrary 仅用于否定刚提及的命题（“恰恰相反”），而对比两个不同群体的表现必须用 by contrast / in contrast / on the other hand。
examples: The report claims that every village was sampled. On the contrary, remote villages were excluded.
Urban use increased; by contrast, rural use remained stable.
common_errors: 把 on the contrary 误当作 on the other hand / by contrast 使用。
段落只有空洞观点句和夸张形容词，缺乏具体机制解释与可核验实例。

grammar_instruction.name: 去除“AI 味（Anti-AI-ese）”与过度修辞：用具体机制、指标与实例替代空洞夸张
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 典型 AI 生成文本充斥着空洞的套话与浮夸副词/形容词（如 delve into, testament to, tapestry, underscores the paramount importance, revolutionize, unparalleled, groundbreaking），却缺乏具体技术细节。地道顶会论文（NeurIPS/ICLR/CoRL）与高分雅思/托福/六级写作追求“低修辞密度、高信息密度”：用具体动词、明确指标和真实实例说话。
rules: 删除无实质信息的“清嗓子”套话（Throat-clearing）：少用 *It is worth noting that / It is undeniable that / In the realm of modern artificial intelligence*，直接陈述事实主干。

禁止“只有夸张形容词而不给实例或数据支撑”：不要写 *The model achieves an enormous, unparalleled improvement*，而要写 *The proposed parametrization reduces MSE by 8.4% relative to the seasonal naive baseline on hourly electricity demand*。
优先选用朴素、精准的单音节或核心学术动词（examine, test, compare, constrain, decompose, bound, mitigate）替代故作高深的修辞词。
examples:
AI 腔/空洞夸张：*This groundbreaking paradigm delves into the intricate tapestry of temporal dynamics and achieves unparalleled accuracy.*
地道学术改写：*This model decomposes the series into trend and seasonal components, achieving lower forecasting error than the linear baseline on three benchmarks.*

六级/雅思空洞句：*Technology has an enormous impact on education in many ways.*
地道具体展开：*Asynchronous learning platforms allow part-time students to review lecture recordings at their own pace, reducing scheduling conflicts.*
common_errors: 堆砌 paramount, unprecedented, revolutionize, multifaceted 等宣传式词汇，违反客观学术语域。
只下宏大判断（如 *This method is very efficient*）而不给出具体的计算复杂度、内存占用或延迟数据。

grammar_instruction.name: 主谓一致、数量短语一致与邻近名词干扰排除
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 复杂主语的主谓一致取决于核心名词（Head Noun）而非后置介词短语中的邻近名词。尤其需区分 a number of 与 the number of，以及 along with / accompanied by / as well as 连接的附加成分。
rules: the number of + 复数名词作主语，谓语用单数；a (large/small) number of + 复数名词作主语，谓语用复数。
主语后接 along with, together with, accompanied by, as well as 时，谓语动词与前面的核心主语保持一致。
the bulk of / a proportion of / a percentage of + 名词作主语时，谓语单复数取决于 of 后的名词是不可数/单数还是复数可数名词。
means, series 单复数同形，谓语由限定词决定（a series of observations was vs two series were）。
examples: The number of completed interviews was recorded separately.
A small number of respondents left this item blank.
The bulk of the evidence comes from observational studies.
One of the surveys was conducted online.
common_errors: 被 of 短语中的复数名词误导：*The analysis of interview responses show（应为 shows）。
把 as well as 误当成 and 改变主语单复数。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 界定概念的操作性定义与数学符号表示
expression_pattern_instruction.template: For the purposes of this analysis, we define [term] as [operational criterion], where [symbol] denotes [quantity].
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 用于将抽象概念转化为可观测、可复现的操作性指标或符号。
examples: We define the outcome as the number of visits per week.
Here, N denotes the number of observations.
common_errors: 定义含糊或符号指代前后不一致。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 同时报告绝对差值与相对变化（区分 % 与百分点）
expression_pattern_instruction.template: [Metric] decreased/increased by [X] percentage points (from [A]% to [B]%), corresponding to a [Y]% relative change.
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 消除百分比歧义，同时给出基线值、绝对差值与相对变化率。
examples: The absolute difference was reported alongside the relative change.
A rise from 20% to 25% is five percentage points.
common_errors: 混淆 percentage points 与 per cent，或隐瞒基数分母。

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：严格线性映射保持原点，仿射映射可有平移项；affine 不能泛指所有非线性变换。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The affine function f(x) = ax + b includes an intercept b.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 理论推导高频词：固定接介词 to（be amenable to analytical treatment），意为“可用解析方法求解/处理”。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The simplified model is amenable to analytical treatment.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：对应名词 anomaly；异常不必然是假值或误差，应依据预先说明的规则处理。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: An anomalous observation should be investigated before it is removed.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：可数名词，复数 anomalies；异常可能来自真实事件、测量误差或模型局限，不能直接判为错误。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: An anomaly in the sensor readings prompted a check of the calibration procedure.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：专业医学词；药物类别名不能证明某药对某人有效；写作中 medication/agent 比将形容词孤立作名词更清楚。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The study records the use of antidiabetic medication at baseline.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：可指具代表性的原型，不等于每个实例都具有全部性质；archetype 是名词，技术说明需给出具体过程假设。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: A random walk with independent identically distributed increments of positive finite variance is an archetypal example of a nonstationary process.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：表达可争论但有理由的判断，仍需说明理由和条件；并非给无证据的绝对判断加一个词就足够。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: A distributional forecast is arguably more informative when decisions depend on tail risk.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：本例指标准化的 Pearson 自相关，要求相应方差有限且非零；恒定序列的归一化自相关因分母为零而未定义；若只写成滞后的函数，需要相应平稳条件；自相关不等于因果作用。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: When the relevant variances are finite and nonzero, lag-one Pearson autocorrelation measures the linear association between observations one time step apart.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：含义依学科而定；canonical form 必须对应具体数学约定，canonical example 指具有代表性的标准例子。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The appendix presents the equation in its canonical form.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：名词常用 a cascade of；动词常用 cascade through；须说明传递路径，不能凭“连锁”一词暗示已验证的因果链。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: A local disruption can cascade through an interconnected supply network.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V00383 adj.] 因果的（例：A causal claim requires more than temporal overlap.）；[V00384 adj.] 因果的；涉及原因与结果的（例：A causal interpretation requires assumptions that are stronger than those needed to describe an association.） | 本条用法约束：不能仅因先后或相关就断定。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: A causal claim requires more than temporal overlap.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V00383 adj.] 因果的（例：A causal claim requires more than temporal overlap.）；[V00384 adj.] 因果的；涉及原因与结果的（例：A causal interpretation requires assumptions that are stronger than those needed to describe an association.） | 本条用法约束：causal effect/relationship；数据中的相关性不能单独确立 causal effect，必须说明研究设计和识别假设。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: A causal interpretation requires assumptions that are stronger than those needed to describe an association.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：causal 与 casual 拼写、含义不同。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: A causal relationship cannot be inferred from prediction accuracy alone.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：不能仅因变量相关就命名为因果证据。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: A causal study requires attention to alternative explanations.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：通常不可数；correlation 指统计关联，causality 关乎干预或机制下的因果主张；Granger causality 有特定预测含义。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: Predictive accuracy alone cannot establish causality.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：in chronological order；chronological age 指实际年龄；不能仅按随机序号排列就称 chronological。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The records are arranged in chronological order before the time-series analysis.
